nodes.summary: The operator `E →L[ℝ] F` associated to a bounded bilinear form `B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] ℝ`, characterized by `⟪bilinearFormSharp B x, y⟫ = B x y`. This is the two-space analogue of Mathlib's `continuousLinearMapOfBilin` (which is stated for `E = F`).
nodes.title: Operator associated to a bounded bilinear form
Banach–Nečas–Babuška equivalence acts as the bilinear form

nodes.summary: The Banach–Nečas–Babuška theorem: a bilinear form satisfying the inf–sup condition and nondegeneracy is itself a continuous linear equivalence `E ≃L[ℝ] (F →L[ℝ] ℝ)`.
nodes.title: Banach–Nečas–Babuška theorem

nodes.summary: The variational problem has a solution with the stability bound `‖x‖ ≤ β⁻¹ * ‖φ‖`.
nodes.title: Stability bound for the inf-sup variational problem

nodes.summary: The variational problem `B x y = φ y` for all `y` has a unique solution.
nodes.title: Unique solvability of the inf-sup variational problem

nodes.summary: The inf–sup condition in classical supremum form.
nodes.title: Inf-sup condition in supremum form

nodes.summary: The inf–sup condition: there is `β > 0` such that `β * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖B x‖` for every `x`. The right-hand side is the dual norm of the functional `B x`, i.e. `sup_{‖y‖ ≤ 1} |B x y|` (see `norm_apply_eq_iSup`).
nodes.title: Inf-sup condition

nodes.summary: The only `y` annihilated by every `B x` is `y = 0`.
nodes.title: Nondegeneracy in the second variable

nodes.summary: The dual norm is the supremum over the closed unit ball.
nodes.title: Dual norm as a supremum over the unit ball

nodes.summary: The norm of `sharpEquiv` applied to `x` is the dual norm of `B x`.
nodes.title: Norm of the Banach–Nečas–Babuška isomorphism applied to a vector

nodes.summary: Pointwise inverse bound for `sharpEquiv`: the inverse operator is bounded by `β⁻¹` when `β` is an inf–sup constant.
nodes.title: Pointwise inverse bound for the Banach–Nečas–Babuška isomorphism

nodes.summary: Operator-norm bound for the inverse: `‖(sharpEquiv)⁻¹‖ ≤ β⁻¹`.
nodes.title: Operator-norm bound for the inverse Banach–Nečas–Babuška isomorphism

nodes.summary: The inf–sup condition makes `bilinearFormSharp B` antilipschitz.
nodes.title: Inf-sup condition makes the associated operator antilipschitz

nodes.summary: The equivalence `sharpEquiv` is characterized by the bilinear form.
nodes.title: Banach–Nečas–Babuška isomorphism is characterized by the form

nodes.summary: The Banach–Nečas–Babuška isomorphism: the operator associated to a bilinear form satisfying the inf–sup condition and nondegeneracy is a continuous linear equivalence.
nodes.title: Banach–Nečas–Babuška isomorphism

nodes.summary: The inf–sup condition makes the range of `bilinearFormSharp B` closed.
nodes.title: Inf-sup condition makes the associated operator's range closed

nodes.summary: The inf–sup condition makes `bilinearFormSharp B` injective.
nodes.title: Inf-sup condition makes the associated operator injective

nodes.summary: The inf–sup condition plus nondegeneracy make `bilinearFormSharp B` surjective: the orthogonal complement of its range is trivial, and a closed subspace of a Hilbert space with trivial orthogonal complement is everything.
nodes.title: Inf-sup and nondegeneracy make the associated operator surjective

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
